title: cornus alba var. baileyi
intro: Cornus alba var. baileyi, commonly known as Red-veined Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub native to China, characterized by its reddish-brown bark and white flowers. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cornus alba var. baileyi are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cognitive function, and exhibit anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
